title: VULCAN Commercial Leg Extension & Leg Curl Machine – 120kg Weight Stack | IN STOCK
description:
IN STOCK

The VULCAN Commercial Leg Extension/ Leg Curl machine is perfect for clinics and professional gym fitouts. The main key features of this machine is a 120kg Weight Stack, 1:1 weight ratio and 3mm thick steel. All further important features are listed below!

Features:

  • 120kg Weight Stack (1:1): The VULCAN Commercial Leg Extension/ Leg Curl machine has a huge 120kg weight stack capability with increments of 5kg, allowing for small and fast jumps between exercises.

  • Dual Capability: This specialised machine offers both leg extension and seated leg curl for hamstrings and quadriceps.

  • Multiple Adjustable Settings: There are multiple different settings for the feet, leg and seating padding to allow for optimal positions for every user while exercising.

  • Build Quality: We use 3mm thick steel, with thick padding, aluminium alloy pulleys and intricate parts maximise durability and strength of the machine. The leg extension/ curl machine weighs 228kg with a 130cm x 99cm footprint which increases stability while maximising floor space.

  • Crate Dimensions: 167cm x 115cm x 55cm (303kg)

Trusted buy strength & conditioning gyms, commercial setups, physios, and high end home gym builds, the VULCAN Commercial Leg Extension/ Leg Curl machine is a must have for rehab and strength training of all types.
